items.name: Edge Compute & Industrial Networks
items.description: Industrial-grade routers, gateways, and SD-WAN solutions for mission-critical connectivity in harsh environments. Our SILBO product line powers connectivity for tower companies, utilities, and manufacturers.

items.name: Telecom Tower Infrastructure
items.description: End-to-end remote monitoring and operations automation for passive telecom infrastructure. Alarm management, energy optimisation, field mobility, and trouble ticketing — deployed across 150K+ sites in 32 countries.

items.name: Solar & Renewable Energy
items.description: Real-time visibility over solar and hybrid energy assets. Integrated monitoring, billing, and analytics from edge devices to cloud dashboards — supporting both on-grid and off-grid deployments.

items.name: Smart Energy & Utilities
items.description: Tariff-grade smart meters and IoT-enabled utility management. Automated billing, consumption analytics, and regulatory compliance for utilities, municipalities, and industrial consumers.

items.name: ESG & Sustainability for Solar Applications
items.description: ESG reporting and sustainability analytics built directly on real-time energy data. Track carbon footprint, renewable energy credits, and compliance metrics automatically — no manual data entry.
